51616737.protein: NACHT, LRR and PYD domains-containing protein 3
51616737.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM5 chip immobilized NLRP3 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Direct binding of compounds to protein was detected using Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR). The specific experimental steps are: Dilute NLRP3 to 100 ng/μl with pH 4.0 sodium acetate buffer to make NLRP3 positively charged and immobilize NLRP3 on the CM5 chip by amino coupling, with a response value of about 15000 Ru. For the reference track, only the surface of the closed chip was activated, and NLRP3 was not immobilized. The buffer solution was: PBS-P. Prepare 5% compounds with different concentration gradients and DMSO calibration solutions (4.5%-5.8%) while ensuring that the DMSO content in the buffer solution is 5%. Compounds of different concentrations are made to flow through the surface of the chip in turn. If the compound interacts with NLRP3, a binding and dissociation curve will be generated. If there is no interaction, there will be no response signal. Regeneration is achieved by flushing with buffer solutions after each injection.
original_paragraph.Figure 10 caption: Fig. 10. (A, B). CSC-6 directly binds to NLRP3. SPR and (C). Cellular Thermal Shift Assay (CETSA) determines the binding of NLRP3 to CSC-6.
